caption: Twenty natural proteins, selected before inference (five per MSA tier). Each oracle is compared with five uniform and five separation-matched random maps; unknown mask, positive/negative counts, and three-sample diffusion budgets are identical. Select each map’s structure by Helico ranking_score. Confidence wins are paired within protein; ties count half. Intervals bootstrap proteins, not samples. Random maps are weak negatives; this does not establish ranking of plausible alternative folds.
